test_cases.name: Landscape Description
test_cases.input: Describe this landscape. What time of day do you think it is?
success_criteria: Provides a detailed description of the landscape (grass, stones, mountains, sky)
Makes a reasonable estimate of the time of day (Sunset, Dawn, Noon, Sunrise, etc.)

test_cases.name: Animal Identification
test_cases.input: What animal is this and what is it doing?
success_criteria: Animal is a dog
Running at the beach close to waves

test_cases.name: Food Analysis
test_cases.input: What ingredients can you identify in this dish?
success_criteria: Provides a general description of the type of dish such as a salad and an orange juice
Ingredients of salad include olives, walnuts, onion, salad, carrots, feta

test_cases.name: Architecture Identification
test_cases.input: What style of architecture is shown in this image?
success_criteria: Brutalist architecture
Stadium / concert hall or similar building

test_cases.name: Weather Assessment
test_cases.input: Based on this image, what's the weather like?
success_criteria: Describes the apparent weather conditions (snowing)
Provides evidence from the image to support the weather assessment

test_cases.name: Art Style Analysis
test_cases.input: What style of painting is this? Describe its key features.
success_criteria: Identifies the style of painting (abstract art)
Describes key features and techniques visible in the artwork

test_cases.name: Vehicle Identification
test_cases.input: What type of vehicle is this and what era is it from?
success_criteria: Trabant produced in east germany
Provides an estimate of the era or decade the vehicle is from (produced from 1957 to 1991)

test_cases.name: Sports Scene Analysis
test_cases.input: What sport is being played here and what's happening in the image?
success_criteria: Identifies the sport being played (ball sports) and the specific sport (football)
Describes the specific action or moment captured in the image (ball hitting the goal)

test_cases.name: Technology Identification
test_cases.input: What piece of technology is shown here and what might it be used for?
success_criteria: Correctly identifies the piece of technology (computer in a labratory setting)

test_cases.name: Clothes Recognition
test_cases.input: What is the person wearing?
success_criteria: Identifies that the person is wearing a dark jacket and a pink cap
